name: Blue Sheep Hunt in Shimshal Valley
description: 15 to 16-day guided blue sheep hunt in Shimshal Valley, District Hunza, Islamabad to Islamabad, full board, including a two-day trek in and out. Legal hunting period 1 November to 30 April; recommended November, March and April. 3,200 to 4,500 m. Pricing for 2027-28 on request.
